label: Services
description: Every service in two columns, why us, questions and the ask button.

settings.text: From a dripping tap to a new bathroom, one call.

settings.title: Licensed & insured
settings.text: Every technician carries a state licence and we are insured to $5M.

settings.title: Upfront pricing
settings.text: A fixed price before we start, never a meter running by the hour.

settings.title: Same-day callouts
settings.text: Call before noon and a technician is at your door the same day.

settings.title: Every job guaranteed
settings.text: Twelve months on parts and labour, written on every invoice.

settings.question: Do you charge a callout fee?
settings.answer: No. You pay for the job at the price we agree before we start.

settings.question: Are you insured?
settings.answer: Yes, fully licensed and insured to $5M. We show the certificate on request.

settings.question: How fast can you come?
settings.answer: For an emergency, usually within the hour. Everything else, the same or next day.

settings.question: Do you offer financing?
settings.answer: Yes, on new boilers and bathrooms: spread the cost over 24 months, subject to credit approval.

settings.question: Do you work weekends?
settings.answer: Yes. We book work Monday to Saturday, 7:00 to 18:00, and the emergency line answers every day.

settings.question: Is the estimate really free?
settings.answer: Yes. We come out, look and give you a fixed price in writing. You owe nothing unless you go ahead.

settings.question: What areas do you cover?
settings.answer: Ashby and ten towns within 40 miles of it. Every town is on our areas page.

settings.question: Can offers be combined?
settings.answer: One offer per job, and offers cannot be combined with a plan discount.
